value.rationale: The BB interval is a canonical spectral-gradient choice and constrained variants often add projection specifically to control feasibility. This result gives the exact condition-number boundary at which the raw interval is already nonnegative after an exact-line warm start and shows that above it even the conservative short endpoint cannot prevent a two-dimensional sign failure. The all-selector phase boundary is a structural safety result rather than a routine single-instance calculation.
